profiles.name: Campfire
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A campfire at night under pines and stars, the artwork as a polaroid propped on a stone in its flickering light. Flames rise with the music, beats throw sparks
manifest.name: Campfire

profiles.name: Resonance
profiles.author: Lush

manifest.description: A liquid-glass ball that morphs with every frequency of the song, holding the artwork in focus while it fills the screen behind, blurred (animated artwork too). - Helped with Claude Code
manifest.name: Resonance

profiles.name: Sea
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Realistické moře a obloha. Klidná hudba = slunce za coverem a hladká hladina, tvrdá = zataženo, velké vlny, pěna, déšť a blesky do beatu.
manifest.name: Sea

profiles.name: Night-Drive
profiles.author: Jstr

manifest.description: Striped sun behind neon mountains, mirrored in a racing grid floor, through a VHS CRT. Bass pumps the sun and grid, beats glitch and glow.
manifest.name: Night-Drive

profiles.name: Heatmap
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A liquid thermal lens on black. Cobalt halos and molten edges bend with the bass; tilt moves the light and refraction.
manifest.name: Heatmap

profiles.name: KIN'S CORE_HUB
profiles.author: KIN

manifest.description: terminal style visualizer with toggles and glitch control
manifest.name: KIN'S CORE_HUB

profiles.name: Lighthouse
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A lighthouse on dark rocks at night: the beam turns once a bar through sea mist and flashes as it faces you, swells follow the energy, beats break white on the rocks
manifest.name: Lighthouse

profiles.name: Kin's CRT Album
profiles.author: KIN

manifest.description: retro CRT: aurora, scope, pitch LEDs, spectrum side meters, animated covers, track swipe and title
manifest.name: Kin's CRT Album

profiles.name: AOT - Paths
profiles.author: listener-f58e3f

manifest.description: The tree of the Paths: glowing roots over a frozen desert, pulsing with the music.
manifest.name: AOT - Paths

profiles.name: Smoke
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork breathing smoke of its own colours, curling off its edges and thicker on the beat
manifest.name: Smoke

profiles.name: Simple Pulse
profiles.author: Brodes

manifest.description: A centred cover with panels that pulse, with adjustable gradient and middle panel artwork. Thanks to iane8 for OG idea and suggesting features here.
manifest.name: Simple Pulse

profiles.name: Ferrofluid
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The cover as a lit print standing in a pool of black magnetic fluid that the music pulls into a field of glossy spikes
manifest.name: Ferrofluid

profiles.name: Holo
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork as a holographic card that leans as you tilt the phone, its rainbow foil and glints catching the light
manifest.name: Holo

profiles.name: Kaleido
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The animated artwork folded into a kaleidoscope round the cover, streaming outward and kicked along by each beat
manifest.name: Kaleido

profiles.name: Northern Lights
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Northern lights over a still Nordic lake: curtains in the cover's colours ripple with the song, flare on the beat and shimmer with the highs, mirrored in the water
manifest.name: Northern Lights

profiles.name: Jukebox
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A 1950s arched jukebox: warm plastic panels cycling round the arch, bubble tubes, and the song's sleeve in the carousel above a spinning 45
manifest.name: Jukebox

profiles.name: Cassette
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A cassette with the cover on its label: the reels turn with the tempo, the tape winds from left to right through the song and a small meter follows the loudness
manifest.name: Cassette

profiles.name: Fireflies
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A forest clearing at dusk, the artwork hanging from a branch in a wooden frame. Fireflies flash together in a wave on every beat, and louder music wakes more of them
manifest.name: Fireflies

profiles.name: Simplex Flow
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Domain-warped simplex noise in the cover's colours; bass warps, beats kick, treble adds detail.
manifest.name: Simplex Flow

profiles.name: Oscilloscope
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: An analog oscilloscope: the song's waveform traced on a phosphor screen that fades slowly, with the cover burnt faintly into the glass behind the graticule
manifest.name: Oscilloscope

profiles.name: Hyperspace
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A flight down a tunnel panelled with the artwork: seams glow with the song, the flight surges on beats, and the cover waits at the far end
manifest.name: Hyperspace

profiles.name: Snow Globe
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork on a little card inside a water-filled snow globe on a turned base. Beats swirl the snow up, it settles slowly, tilting the phone sloshes it
manifest.name: Snow Globe

profiles.name: Fluidity
profiles.author: Brodes

manifest.description: Fluid, Simple.
manifest.name: Fluidity

profiles.name: Watch
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: An open-heart mechanical watch with the album art as its dial: the balance swings at the song's tempo, the escapement ticks on every beat
manifest.name: Watch

profiles.name: AOT - Paths #2
profiles.author: listener-f58e3f

manifest.description: The tree of the Paths: glowing roots over a frozen desert, pulsing with the music.
manifest.name: AOT - Paths #2

profiles.name: Vinyl
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The cover as the label of a spinning record. Grooves glow with the spectrum; the tonearm follows the track's progress and lifts when paused.
manifest.name: Vinyl

profiles.name: Tide
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork at the edge of dark water, its reflection rippled by the bass and ringed on each beat; tilt the phone and the water stays level
manifest.name: Tide

profiles.name: Rain
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Rain on a window at night: the cover sharp behind fogged glass, city lights out of focus, drops that slide on the beat and a far-off flash of thunder on the bass
manifest.name: Rain

profiles.name: Starry Sky
profiles.author: Brodes

manifest.description: The cover as a planet in a streaming starfield, with a nebula and a beat flash.
manifest.name: Starry Sky

profiles.name: Bloom
profiles.author: Salvo

manifest.description: The cover in a white ring that bursts into bass ears and wings with a rainbow fringe on every hit, over the artwork with drifting particles.
manifest.name: Bloom

profiles.name: Kaleidoscope
profiles.author: Darkk

params.label: Show the cover now and then

manifest.description: The artwork through the eyepiece of a brass kaleidoscope: mirrored segments, tumbling glass in the cover's colours, a turn on each beat and the plain cover now and then
manifest.name: Kaleidoscope

profiles.name: Black hole
profiles.author: armandillo

manifest.description: 3D black hole: gravitational lensing, accretion disk with Doppler effect, photon ring, and stars. Reacts to bass, beat, and album art colors. Vibe-coded with Claude.
manifest.name: Black hole

profiles.name: Ripple
profiles.author: Lush

manifest.description: A ball of water...?
manifest.name: Ripple

profiles.name: Hyperbolic Cover
profiles.author: saveurlocalcats

manifest.description: The cover tiled across a Poincare disk, Escher style, drifting through hyperbolic space.
manifest.name: Hyperbolic Cover

profiles.name: Fullscreen Artwork
profiles.author: listener-1fdc1e

manifest.description: The artwork fills the top of the screen and melts into a soft, dark blur of itself below.
manifest.name: Fullscreen Artwork

profiles.name: WWDC26
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The Apple logo as glass lit from inside: light sweeps through it with amber and blue edges, a thin rim and a soft bloom, after WWDC26
manifest.name: WWDC26

profiles.name: VU Meters
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Two backlit VU meters on a hi-fi faceplate with the album sleeve standing on top: the needles swing with real meter ballistics and pin at +3 on loud peaks
manifest.name: VU Meters

profiles.name: Lava Lamp
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A chrome-and-glass lava lamp glowing in a dark room. Louder music heats it: the wax rises faster, swells with the bass and shivers on the beat.
manifest.name: Lava Lamp

profiles.name: Radio
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A 1950s walnut valve radio with the album photo standing on top: the dial needle tunes across the band with the song, the magic eye closes with the loudness
manifest.name: Radio

profiles.name: Waterfall
profiles.author: Brodes

manifest.description: Streams of light fall down the screen behind the cover, with an adjustable background fade. Thank you iane8 for suggesting tweaks to this shader.
manifest.name: Waterfall

profiles.name: Planet
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork as the surface of a ringed planet turning in space: rings that shimmer with the spectrum, a ripple on every beat, a passing moon and a deep starfield
manifest.name: Planet

profiles.name: Cyberpunk Radio V1
profiles.author: saveurlocalcats

manifest.description: Cyberpunk-style radio tuner: cover, title, artist and album on a glitchy HUD that reacts to the beat.
manifest.name: Cyberpunk Radio V1

profiles.name: Skeumorphic
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The cover on the screen of a hardware deck: a knob that turns through the song, meters, a scrolling waveform and a button that keeps the beat
manifest.name: Skeumorphic

profiles.name: Kin's Chroma Live Portrait Remake
profiles.author: KIN

manifest.description: Chroma web player portrait UI: blurred saturated backdrop, rounded cover, title, artist, progress bar and timestamps
manifest.name: Kin's Chroma Live Portrait Remake

profiles.name: Siri Visualizer
profiles.author: Lush

manifest.description: Glowing Siri-style lobes swell with the lows, mids and highs over the song's artwork, or over its animated artwork full screen when it has one.
manifest.name: Siri Visualizer

profiles.name: Windows XP
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A homage to the early-2000s media player visualizers: a swirling feedback tunnel with an oscilloscope ring and orbiting spectrum dots.
manifest.name: Windows XP

profiles.name: Retro Dash
profiles.author: Jstr

manifest.description: A VFD car-dash cluster: curved tach, a 14-segment status line, 7-segment clock, spectrum with peak hold, a little 3D race behind an F40 or the cover, two VU gauges.
manifest.name: Retro Dash

profiles.name: Ripple Grid
profiles.author: nugraizy

manifest.description: A field of columns that rise with the music. Bass sends ripples across the grid, with falling meteors and a choice of colours or album artwork tint.
manifest.name: Ripple Grid

profiles.name: In Space
profiles.author: saveurlocalcats

manifest.description: You, looking out a spaceship window. The cover is the planet outside; the moon, stars, ship lights and warp speed all follow the song's tempo and beat.
manifest.name: In Space

profiles.name: Deep Note Crystal
profiles.author: Jstr

manifest.description: Die THX-Deep-Note-Kristallfläche: Facetten-Ringe um das Cover, die mit der Musik aufladen, pulsieren und in 2–3 Farben aus dem Cover schimmern.
manifest.name: Deep Note Crystal

profiles.name: Beat Ink
profiles.author: Jstr

manifest.description: The cover's colours bleed into a living fluid: ink fed by the spectrum, stirred by the bass, splashed by beats, torn into marbled streaks.
manifest.name: Beat Ink

profiles.name: Wavy Visualizer
profiles.author: nugraizy

manifest.description: Scrolling audio bars with glowy and distorted waves.
manifest.name: Wavy Visualizer

profiles.name: Siri AI
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A fluid Siri light with glass refraction, soft reflections and a vivid rainbow glow around the entire screen. The lower centre stays dark for player controls.
manifest.name: Siri AI

profiles.name: Mosaic
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The animated artwork on an LED wall round the cover, its columns lit by the spectrum from the middle out
manifest.name: Mosaic

profiles.name: Fracture
profiles.author: Salvo

manifest.description: Shards of the artwork fly out from behind the cover, streaming faster and burning brighter as the song gets louder, flashing on every beat.
manifest.name: Fracture

profiles.name: Pulse
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: Rings step out from the cover on every beat, gliding at the song's tempo; every fourth one is bolder
manifest.name: Pulse

profiles.name: Aquarium
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A planted fish tank in a dark room, the artwork as its back print. Caustics, swaying eelgrass, an air stone that puffs on beats and a small school in the cover's colours
manifest.name: Aquarium

profiles.name: Glitter
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The artwork in holographic glitter glue: thousands of tiny flakes that flash and shift colour as you tilt the phone
manifest.name: Glitter

profiles.name: DVD
profiles.author: Brodes

manifest.description: The cover bounces around the screen like a DVD logo, with adjustable size and animated cover support.
manifest.name: DVD

profiles.name: Split Flap
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The cover rebuilt on a split-flap board, one colour a flap. Beats flip short runs, busy songs rewrite whole rows, and a new song flips the board through to its cover.
manifest.name: Split Flap

profiles.name: Windows Media Player V1
profiles.author: saveurlocalcats

manifest.description: The old red Windows Media Player with a glowing bars-and-waves visualiser. Pick the skin colour or let it match the song.
manifest.name: Windows Media Player V1

profiles.name: Still Water
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: The cover lying under still water: beats and bass drop rings across it, the highs ruffle the surface, caustics play on the artwork, and quiet passages settle to glass
manifest.name: Still Water

profiles.name: Jewel Case
profiles.author: Darkk

manifest.description: A clear CD case with the cover printed on the disc inside. Tilt the phone and the light slides over the plastic while the disc splits it into rainbows
manifest.name: Jewel Case

profiles.name: NCS - Remake
profiles.author: Lush

manifest.description: A copy of Konsl's Spicetify visualizer: dots warped onto a sphere, a glowing ring that swells with the music and a lattice that floods its face when loud, over the blurred artwork.
manifest.name: NCS - Remake
